title: Chunk options: what each chunk shows

steps.say: Options go on #| lines at the top of a chunk. message: false drops the notes the tidyverse and readr print while they load and read.
echo: false hides the code and keeps the chart: what a reader of a report wants to see.
A setup chunk with include: false runs first and shows nothing at all. The tidyverse and the data load once, quietly, at the top.
code-fold: true tucks each chunk's code behind a Code button. Readers see results; the curious can click.
For a report that goes to managers, hide code everywhere: execute: echo: false in the YAML covers every chunk, in every format.

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
rates <- read_csv("unemployment.csv")
```

## Summary

Unemployment **fell** in most regions between 2022 and 2025.
*Jazan* is the exception. This note shows the national
trend and the latest rates.[^1]
The data cover:

- 13 regions and the Kingdom as a whole
- 16 quarters, from 2022 Q1 to 2025 Q4

Official figures are on the [GASTAT website](https://www.stats.gov.sa).

[^1]: All figures in this note are synthetic, made for training.

## Method

The unemployment rate is

$$
u = \frac{U}{U + E} \times 100
$$

where $U$ is the number unemployed and $E$ the number employed.

## Data

```{r}
glimpse(rates)
```

## Trend

```{r}
kingdom <- rates |> filter(region == "Kingdom")
ggplot(kingdom, aes(date, rate)) + geom_line()
```
